description: Returns the newest air quality readings of the automatic stations of the National Environmental Agency of Georgia (NEA), for a city, one station, or every station. Each reading gives PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2, or CO, its concentration (µg/m³, CO in mg/m³), its hour, and its level: good, fair, moderate, poor, or very_poor. A station level is its worst reading. Stations come worst first. A reading older than 24 hours is left out. The NEA stamps some readings a few hours ahead of the clock: the time is as published. Data from the NEA.

city.description: A city of Georgia in English or Georgian, for example Tbilisi or რუსთავი. Leave city and station empty for every station.

language.description: The language of the addresses and the cities: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of stations, 1 to 100. The default is 25.

station.description: A station code of the NEA, for example TSRT. Give a city or a station, not both.

name: air_get_quality

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the readings, RFC 3339.

source.description: The source of the data: National Environmental Agency.

stale.description: True when the NEA did not answer and the server returns readings it read before.

stations.description: The stations, the worst level first. A station with no level comes last.

city.description: The city or the municipality of the station.

code.description: The station code of the NEA.

level.description: The worst level of the readings: good, fair, moderate, poor, or very_poor. Empty when no reading has a level.

readings.description: The newest reading of each pollutant, less than 24 hours old. Empty when the station sent none.

level.description: good, fair, moderate, poor, or very_poor. Empty for a negative value.

pollutant.description: PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2, or CO.

time.description: The hour of the reading as the NEA publishes it, RFC 3339 with +04:00.

value.description: The concentration as a decimal string, as the NEA publishes it. It can be negative.

total.description: The count of matching stations. More than the count of stations when the limit cut the list.

title: Get the air quality in Georgia
